const std = @import("std");
const math = std.math;
const mem = std.mem;
const testing = std.testing;
const Allocator = mem.Allocator;
pub const DType = enum { f64, f32, i64, i32 };
pub const Shape = []const usize;
fn totalElements(shape: Shape) usize { var t: usize = 1; for (shape) |d| t *= d; return t; }
pub const Tensor = struct {
    allocator: Allocator,
    data: []f64,
    shape: []usize,
    strides: []usize,
    dtype: DType = .f64,
    offset: usize = 0,
    is_view: bool = false,
    requires_grad: bool = false,
    grad: ?*Tensor = null,
    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator, shape_in: Shape, dtype: DType) !Tensor {
        const total = totalElements(shape_in);
        var data = try allocator.alloc(f64, total);
        @memset(data, 0);
        var shape = try allocator.dupe(usize, shape_in);
        var strides = try allocator.alloc(usize, shape.len);
        if (shape.len > 0) {
            strides[shape.len - 1] = 1;
            var i: usize = shape.len;
            while (i > 1) : (i -= 1) { strides[i - 1] = strides[i] * shape[i]; }
        }
        return .{ .allocator = allocator, .data = data, .shape = shape, .strides = strides, .dtype = dtype, .offset = 0, .is_view = false, .requires_grad = false, .grad = null };
    }
    pub fn deinit(self: *Tensor) void {
        if (!self.is_view) self.allocator.free(self.data);
        self.allocator.free(self.shape);
        self.allocator.free(self.strides);
        if (self.grad) |g| { g.deinit(); self.allocator.destroy(g); }
    }
    fn flatIndex(self: *const Tensor, idxs: []const usize) usize {
        var idx: usize = self.offset;
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < idxs.len) : (i += 1) idx += idxs[i] * self.strides[i];
        return idx;
    }
    pub fn get(self: *const Tensor, idxs: []const usize) f64 {
        const i = self.flatIndex(idxs);
        return self.data[i];
    }
    pub fn set(self: *Tensor, idxs: []const usize, v: f64) void {
        const i = self.flatIndex(idxs);
        self.data[i] = v;
    }
    pub fn view(self: *const Tensor, allocator: Allocator, new_shape_in: Shape) !Tensor {
        if (totalElements(self.shape) != totalElements(new_shape_in)) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        var shape = try allocator.dupe(usize, new_shape_in);
        var strides = try allocator.alloc(usize, new_shape_in.len);
        if (new_shape_in.len > 0) {
            strides[new_shape_in.len - 1] = 1;
            var i: usize = new_shape_in.len;
            while (i > 1) : (i -= 1) strides[i - 1] = strides[i] * new_shape_in[i];
        }
        return .{ .allocator = self.allocator, .data = self.data, .shape = shape, .strides = strides, .dtype = self.dtype, .offset = self.offset, .is_view = true, .requires_grad = self.requires_grad, .grad = self.grad };
    }
    pub fn reshape(self: *Tensor, allocator: Allocator, new_shape: Shape) !Tensor { return self.view(allocator, new_shape); }
    pub fn add(self: *const Tensor, other: *const Tensor, result: *Tensor) !void {
        if (self.shape.len != other.shape.len or self.shape.len != result.shape.len) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        if (!mem.eql(usize, self.shape, other.shape) or !mem.eql(usize, self.shape, result.shape)) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        const total = totalElements(self.shape);
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < total) : (i += 1) result.data[i] = self.data[i] + other.data[i];
    }
    pub fn mul(self: *const Tensor, other: *const Tensor, result: *Tensor) !void {
        if (self.shape.len != other.shape.len or self.shape.len != result.shape.len) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        if (!mem.eql(usize, self.shape, other.shape) or !mem.eql(usize, self.shape, result.shape)) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        const total = totalElements(self.shape);
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < total) : (i += 1) result.data[i] = self.data[i] * other.data[i];
    }
    pub fn matmul(self: *const Tensor, other: *const Tensor, result: *Tensor) !void {
        if (self.shape.len != 2 or other.shape.len != 2 or result.shape.len != 2) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        const m = self.shape; const k = self.shape; const k2 = other.shape; const n = other.shape;[1]
        if (k != k2 or result.shape != m or result.shape != n) return error.ShapeMismatch;[1]
        @memset(result.data, 0);
        var i: usize = 0; while (i < m) : (i += 1) {
            var j: usize = 0; while (j < n) : (j += 1) {
                var s: f64 = 0.0;
                var t: usize = 0; while (t < k) : (t += 1) s += self.data[i * k + t] * other.data[t * n + j];
                result.data[i * n + j] = s;
            }
        }
    }
    pub fn transpose(self: *const Tensor, result: *Tensor) !void {
        if (self.shape.len != 2 or result.shape.len != 2) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        const m = self.shape; const n = self.shape;[1]
        if (result.shape != n or result.shape != m) return error.ShapeMismatch;[1]
        var i: usize = 0; while (i < m) : (i += 1) {
            var j: usize = 0; while (j < n) : (j += 1) result.data[j * m + i] = self.data[i * n + j];
        }
    }
    pub fn relu(self: *const Tensor, result: *Tensor) !void {
        if (!mem.eql(usize, self.shape, result.shape)) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        const total = totalElements(self.shape);
        var i: usize = 0; while (i < total) : (i += 1) result.data[i] = if (self.data[i] > 0.0) self.data[i] else 0.0;
    }
    pub fn softmax(self: *const Tensor, result: *Tensor) !void {
        if (!mem.eql(usize, self.shape, result.shape)) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        const total = totalElements(self.shape);
        var maxv: f64 = -math.inf(f64);
        var i: usize = 0; while (i < total) : (i += 1) if (self.data[i] > maxv) maxv = self.data[i];
        var sum: f64 = 0.0; i = 0; while (i < total) : (i += 1) { const e = math.exp(self.data[i] - maxv); result.data[i] = e; sum += e; }
        i = 0; while (i < total) : (i += 1) result.data[i] = result.data[i] / sum;
    }
    pub fn clone(self: *const Tensor, allocator: Allocator) !Tensor {
        var t = try Tensor.init(allocator, self.shape, self.dtype);
        @memcpy(t.data, self.data);
        return t;
    }
    pub fn zero_grad(self: *Tensor) void { if (self.grad) |g| @memset(g.data, 0); }
};

defmodule JAIDE.Manager do
  use GenServer
  require Logger
  @type worker_id :: atom()
  @type metrics :: %{queue_length: non_neg_integer(), avg_completion_time: float(), task_count: non_neg_integer()}
  @type state :: %{
          workers: %{worker_id() => pid()},
          task_queue: :queue.queue({any(), integer()}),
          idle_workers: [worker_id()],
          completed_tasks: non_neg_integer(),
          metrics: metrics(),
          config: map()
        }
  @spec start_link(map()) :: GenServer.on_start()
  def start_link(config \\ %{}), do: GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, config, name: __MODULE__)
  @spec submit_task(any()) :: :ok
  def submit_task(task), do: GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:new_task, task})
  @spec get_metrics() :: metrics()
  def get_metrics(), do: GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_metrics)
  @spec scale_workers(non_neg_integer()) :: :ok
  def scale_workers(num), do: GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:scale_workers, num})
  @impl true
  def init(config) do
    num_workers = Map.get(config, :num_workers, System.schedulers_online() * 2)
    workers = start_workers(num_workers)
    state = %{
      workers: workers,
      task_queue: :queue.new(),
      idle_workers: Map.keys(workers),
      completed_tasks: 0,
      metrics: %{queue_length: 0, avg_completion_time: 0.0, task_count: 0},
      config: config
    }
    Process.send_after(self(), :update_metrics, 5000)
    {:ok, state}
  end
  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:new_task, task}, state) do
    q = :queue.in({task, System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)}, state.task_queue)
    dispatch(%{state | task_queue: q})
  end
  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:scale_workers, num}, state) do
    cur = map_size(state.workers)
    diff = num - cur
    new_workers =
      if diff > 0 do
        Enum.reduce(1..diff, state.workers, fn i, acc ->
          {:ok, pid} = JAIDE.Worker.start_link(cur + i)
          Map.put(acc, String.to_atom("worker_#{cur + i}"), pid)
        end)
      else
        to_remove = Enum.take(Map.keys(state.workers), abs(diff))
        Enum.reduce(to_remove, state.workers, fn k, acc -> Map.delete(acc, k) end)
      end
    new_idle = Enum.filter(state.idle_workers, &Map.has_key?(new_workers, &1))
    dispatch(%{state | workers: new_workers, idle_workers: new_idle})
  end
  @impl true
  def handle_info({:worker_ready, worker_pid}, state) do
    worker_id = Enum.find_value(state.workers, fn {id, pid} -> if pid == worker_pid, do: id, else: nil end)
    idle = if worker_id, do: Enum.uniq([worker_id | state.idle_workers]), else: state.idle_workers
    dispatch(%{state | idle_workers: idle})
  end
  @impl true
  def handle_info({:task_complete, worker_pid, _result, start_time}, state) do
    completion = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - start_time
    worker_id = Enum.find_value(state.workers, fn {id, pid} -> if pid == worker_pid, do: id, else: nil end)
    idle = if worker_id, do: Enum.uniq([worker_id | state.idle_workers]), else: state.idle_workers
    cnt = state.metrics.task_count + 1
    avg = if state.metrics.task_count == 0, do: completion * 1.0, else: (state.metrics.avg_completion_time * state.metrics.task_count + completion) / cnt
    metrics = %{state.metrics | task_count: cnt, avg_completion_time: avg}
